# NI Business Info

> Northern Ireland's business information hub providing guidance on regulatory compliance, funding opportunities, and innovation programmes for entrepreneurs and enterprises.

NI Business Info aggregates essential business resources for Northern Ireland companies, covering regulatory updates, government consultations, grant schemes, and innovation initiatives. The site serves as a central resource for staying informed about compliance deadlines, funding opportunities, and sector-specific support programmes.

## Key Topics

- Northern Ireland
- Public Consultation
- Regulatory Framework
- Business Growth
- Cyber Essentials
- Financial Services
- Creative Industries
- Innovation Programmes
- Grant Funding
- UK Government
- Female Entrepreneurs
- Import Control System
- Making Tax Digital
- Digital Twin Technology
- Competitiveness Strategy

## Compliance & Regulatory Guidance

- [Get ready for Import Control System 2 (ICS2)](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/get-ready-import-control-system-2-ics2): Guidance on mandatory ICS2 import control system implementation by December 2025
- [Help your clients prepare for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/help-your-clients-prepare-making-tax-digital-income-tax): Guidance for tax agents preparing clients for Making Tax Digital income tax April 2026
- [Consultation: Proposed amendments to the Food Law Code of Practice for Northern Ireland](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/consultation-proposed-amendments-food-law-code-practice-northern-ireland): FSA consultation on Food Law Code of Practice amendments for Northern Ireland
- [Consultation on the Financial Services Sector's regulatory environment](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/consultation-financial-services-sectors-regulatory-environment): HM Treasury consultation on financial services regulatory framework and competitiveness strategy
- [Consultation on control of explosive precursors](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/consultation-control-explosive-precursors): Northern Ireland Office consultation on explosive precursors regulations compliance
- [Consultation on amendments to package travel legislation](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/consultation-amendments-package-travel-legislation): Department for Business and Trade consultation on package travel regulations amendments

## Cyber Security & Digital Innovation

- [Free cyber security advice with a Cyber Advisor](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/free-cyber-security-advice-cyber-advisor): Free NCSC Cyber Advisor programme offering cyber essentials advice to SMEs
- [NI Cyber Essentials Funded Programme](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/ni-cyber-essentials-funded-programme): Free NI Cyber Essentials funded programme for small business cyber security certification
- [UK Digital Twin Centre opens in Belfast](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/uk-digital-twin-centre-opens-belfast): UK Digital Twin Centre launches in Belfast with innovation support for maritime, aerospace sectors
- [Help shape a new standard for built environment digitalisation](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/help-shape-new-standard-built-environment-digitalisation): Public consultation on PAS 1958 standard for built environment data and AI digitalisation

## Business Growth & Entrepreneurship Programmes

- [Grow It NI](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/grow-it-ni): Grow It NI business growth programme for female entrepreneurs in Northern Ireland
- [NHS Innovation Accelerator programme](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/nhs-innovation-accelerator-programme): NHS Innovation Accelerator fellowship programme for healthcare innovation in NI
- [Funding boost for creative industries](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/funding-boost-creative-industries): UK government funding announcement for creative industries growth and regional clusters
- [GBIP in Singapore: MarTech Summit](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/gbip-singapore-martech-summit): Global Business Innovation Programme opportunity at Singapore MarTech Summit Asia

## Grants & Funding Schemes

- [Empty to Energised Grant for Ards and North Down](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/empty-energised-grant-ards-and-north-down): Empty to Energised grant scheme for commercial property renovation in Ards and North Down
- [Cultural Bridge grants for UK-German arts partnerships](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/cultural-bridge-grants-uk-german-arts-partnerships): Cultural Bridge grants funding UK-German arts and community partnerships 2026-2027
- [Northern European Mobility Opportunity (NEMO) call](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/northern-european-mobility-opportunity-nemo-call): NEMO artist mobility and collaboration funding from Nordic Culture Fund
- [Horizon Europe info days in 2026](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/horizon-europe-info-days-2026): Upcoming Horizon Europe info days 2026 for EU research funding opportunities

## Consultations & Environmental Regulations

- [Nutrients Action Programme to Improve Water Quality consultation](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/nutrients-action-programme-improve-water-quality-consultation): DAERA consultation on Nutrients Action Programme for water quality 2026-2029 review

## Events & Industry Preparation

- [The Open Portrush 2025 | Industry update events to help businesses prepare](https://www.nibusinessinfo.co.uk/content/open-portrush-2025-industry-update-events-help-businesses-prepare): Industry preparation events for The Open Championship 2025 golf tourism in Portrush
